import fs from'node:fs';import postcss from'../../ui-mantine-forms-local/contact/node_modules/postcss/lib/postcss.mjs';
const b=new URL('.',import.meta.url).pathname;const original=fs.readFileSync(b+'upstream/obnoxious.css','utf8'),root=postcss.parse(original);root.walkAtRules(rule=>{if(rule.name.endsWith('keyframes')&&rule.params==='strobe')rule.remove()});root.walkRules(rule=>{if(/(^|[\s,.])\.strobe\b/.test(rule.selector)||rule.selector==='.strobe')rule.remove()});const css=root.toString();if(/strobe/.test(css))throw Error('strobe remains');fs.writeFileSync(b+'delivery/runtime.css',fs.readFileSync(b+'upstream/demo/css/styles.css','utf8')+'\n'+css+'\n'+fs.readFileSync(b+'src/host.css','utf8'));

import fs from'node:fs';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{JSDOM}from'../../ui-recogito-adapt/node_modules/jsdom/lib/api.js';import{composePreview}from'../../ui-vault-550/apps/atlas-sample/preview-runtime.mjs';
const p=new URL('.',import.meta.url).pathname,read=n=>fs.readFileSync(p+'delivery/'+n,'utf8'),sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));let reduced=false,hidden=false,mql;const dom=new JSDOM(composePreview(read('index.html'),read('runtime.css'),read('runtime.js'),{cssHref:'runtime.css',scriptSrc:'runtime.js'}),{runScripts:'dangerously',beforeParse(w){mql=new w.EventTarget;Object.defineProperty(mql,'matches',{get:()=>reduced});w.matchMedia=()=>mql;Object.defineProperty(w.document,'hidden',{get:()=>hidden})}});const w=dom.window,d=w.document,h=d.querySelector('h1'),select=d.querySelector('select'),run=d.querySelector('.controls button'),stop=d.getElementById('stop');assert.equal(h.className,'');assert.equal(select.options.length,4);assert(!read('runtime.css').includes('@keyframes strobe'));assert(!d.querySelector('option[value=strobe]'));for(const v of ['shakeit','intensifies','fontalicious','twister']){select.value=v;select.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));await sleep(20);assert(h.classList.contains(v));stop.click();assert.equal(h.className,'')}run.click();hidden=true;d.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('visibilitychange'));await sleep(20);assert.equal(h.className,'');hidden=false;reduced=true;mql.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));assert(run.disabled);select.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));await sleep(20);assert.equal(h.className,'');reduced=false;mql.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));run.click();w.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('atlas:dispose'));await sleep(20);select.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));assert.equal(h.className,'');assert(run.disabled&&select.disabled&&stop.disabled);dom.window.close();console.log(JSON.stringify({actual550Compose:true,originalFourEffects:true,strobeRemoved:true,defaultStatic:true,userStop:true,reducedMotionNoAnimation:true,hiddenCancelsPending:true,exitCancelsAndOldEventsInert:true,visualQA:'not-run'},null,2));

gaps: Strobe is deliberately excluded from runtime CSS and options. Four original effects remain, not a claim of the unmodified five-mode demo.
Google Montserrat font removed; system Arial fallback. All external attribution/share links disabled, no Twitter widget.
Original effect keyframes retained from fixed distributed CSS, but actual motion pixels and native browser visual appearance unverified.
